The supplied relative duality proof5.1 explicitly uses that same signed connector. For alpha degree1 closed, partial(alpha cap [E,partial E])=-alpha|boundary cap [partial E].

findings.countercheck: With R=Z the boundary vector (1,w,-1) in H2(partial E;Z)=Z^3 is nonzero, so it cannot equal its negative. The issue is a real sign mismatch, not a coefficient convention inferred from a different source.
findings.smallest_repair: Insert minus before the boundary cap expression and before the resulting sum, or apply the formula to -alpha. State the same sum is zero after inclusion. Preserve Statement bytewise, all ordinary-coefficient/full winding/choice scope and all other sources.
